sentences.text: It is submitted that by judgment and order dated 24.11.2023 passed in the earlier writ petition being No. WP(C) No.3383/2015 and WP(C) No. 2812/2017 filed by the petitioner, the claim of regularization which was rejected earlier by the department came to be interfered with and the matter was remanded back to the department for a fresh consideration.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Kakoty vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 25 April, 2025.json

sentences.text: However, by the impugned order the authorities proceeded to pass similar orders rejecting the claim of the petitioner on the same ground.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Kakoty vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 25 April, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is therefore submitted that the directions of the Court have been flouted notwithstanding that no appeal or review was filed against the said judgment and order passed in the earlier writ petition by the department/respondents Being aggrieved the petitioner is before this Court seeking for appropriate directions.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Kakoty vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 25 April, 2025.json

sentences.text: Having perused the order dated 29.11.2024, it is directed that the benefit of the same interim order will also be extended to the present writ petitioner.

opennyai_summary.facts:
This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner putting to challenge the impugned order dated 11.04.2025 passed by the respondent No.1 whereby the Page No.
# 3/4 claim of the petitioner for regularization in his post as Inspector of Drugs under the Department of Health and Family Welfare was rejected.
It is submitted that by the impugned order rejecting the claim for regularization the petitioner's services will cease to continue as orders for further extension of his services will not be Pankaj Kakoty vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 25 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128758919/
2 issued by the Department.
opennyai_summary.arguments: It is therefore submitted that the directions of the Court have been flouted notwithstanding that no appeal or review was filed against the said judgment and order passed in the earlier writ petition by the department/respondents Being aggrieved the petitioner is before this Court seeking for appropriate directions.
opennyai_summary.25_April_2025__decision:
It is submitted by the petitioner that writ petition being Nos.6308/2024 and 6309/2024 which filed by the petitioner and another are fixed on 29.04.2025.
It is submitted that by order dated 29.11.2024 in WP(C) Nos. 6308/2024 Page No.# 4/4 and 6309/2024 an interim order was passed till the next date of hearing which has protected the service of the petitioner.
A copy of the said order is placed before this Court.
Having perused the order dated 29.11.2024, it is directed that the benefit of the same interim order will also be extended to the present writ petitioner.
